about: 2.4 GHz at 40 MHz on an automatic channel, kept to the channels that do not overlap (0117). At 40 MHz a channel takes the one four above it too, from 1 to 6, or four below from 7 up, so of 1 to 11 only one stands clear of the rest: channel 1, with 5. The list hostapd picks from is that one channel.
